## FACT round-24 #2 — BERGGREN-3ADIC (paper 81, /tmp/exp_berggren3adic.py, /tmp/r24n2.log)

**Verdict name: THE-TREE-POSITION-IS-ADICALLY-SEALED.**

### Result
The Berggren tree position of the N-node (the Fermat pair of a semiprime, paper 56's exact embedding) carries **NO N-visible residue structure beyond the trace**. The channel decomposes into (i) a deterministic 3-adic skeleton that *restates* N mod 3 exactly, and (ii) a metric layer — branch letters, depth, path composition — that is **blind at every 3-adic level 3^k, k ≤ 6**. The Catalog's 3-adic Cantor boundary (#855) has no N-computable projection beyond the trace-set content.

### The four horns (all stated before the run; all confirmed)
- **H1 SKELETON (deterministic lemma)**: squares mod 3 = {0,1} + m⊥n ⟹ N ≡ 1 ⟺ 3|n, N ≡ 2 ⟺ 3|m, N ≡ 0 ⟺ 3∤mn — agreement **40000/40000 = 100%**. And it RESTATES the trace: 3|n ⟺ q≡p mod 3 ⟺ N ≡ p² ≡ 1 mod 3, also **40000/40000** — zero information beyond N mod 3 (barrier 6).
- **H2 PARENT-INTERVAL LAW (new exact lemma)**: the Berggren parent is decided by the ratio alone — m/n ∈ (1,2) → T₁ = (n,2n−m); (2,3) → T₂ = (n,m−2n); (3,∞) → T₃ = (m−2n,n). Verified on all **40000/40000** descents terminating exactly at root (2,1), plus **86,634 spot-checked steps** with child-map reconstruction (B₁(m,n)=(2m−n,m), B₂=(2m+n,m), B₃=(m+2n,n)) exact on every step.
- **H3 METRIC BLINDNESS**: I(N mod 3^k; b_t) at the 300-shuffle permutation null for every letter depth t ≤ 10 and level k ≤ 6; same for depth dB and composition (c₁,c₂,c₃). **Worst z = +2.51 across ~150 tests** (k=1: I(N mod 3; b₁) = 0.00004 vs null 0.00004, z = +0.04).
- **H4 CONTROLS (live)**: trace lemma I(N mod 3; s mod 3) = **1.0000** exact (paper 50); I(ratio-band; b₁) = **1.4738 = H(b₁)** EXACTLY — the first branch letter is a deterministic function of the m/n band, whose recovery IS the factorization; corr(log dB, log gap) = −0.141 replicates paper 56's anti-correlation.

### Sample
40,000 random semiprimes (p,q uniform primes in [2¹⁶, 2²⁴)), Miller-Rabin (12 bases), capped descents (5000 steps): twin-prime nodes n=1 descend stepwise in m and are censored — **42/40402 = 0.10%**, reported. Runtime 154 s.

- Paper 56's orthogonality is sharpened from coordinate-level to **adic strength**: coordinates orthogonal AND position sealed.
- Tree-adic dials join the closed residue-dial family (papers 54/70/72–74/77/79/80): no dial exceeds its trace-set content; the metric interior requires the factorization to read.
- The gold-tier interference claim (#829, "exact factorisation by interference of Pythagorean triples", polynomial-time per its filename) has no formula in the index, but this result fences it: any such method must either smuggle the Fermat pair (circularity, barrier 6) or pay Ω(N) aggregation (barrier 4).
